_comment: The shape of invites.json, which is gitignored because it holds bearer tokens.
Do not hand-write the real file: `npm run invite -- --name "Their Name"` mints a
32-byte token and appends it. `--list` shows who is invited, `--revoke <id>` removes one.
`id` is permanent. It is written into `surfaced_by` on every record that person creates,
and records are append-only, so reusing an id for a different human silently reassigns
their contribution history. `expires` is optional; omit it for no expiry.
Field names match C2's person columns so the eventual move to Postgres is a copy.

invites.name: Colin Taylor
invites.token: <64 hex characters, minted by npm run invite>
invites.note: operator; SA_INVITE_TOKEN in .env.local points at this one so keepwarm can sign in
